changelog: Fixed critical PowerVR/GLES2 SIGSEGV in glDrawElements (GraphicsThread): CRQ_Commands::rqVertexBufferSelect was passing raw heap address (buffer + 8) to glBindBuffer instead of dereferencing ES2VertexBuffer::bufferId (*(GLuint*)(buffer + 8/12))
Fixed RLEDecompress_hook throwing fake rled error 3 on multi-block/concurrent texture reads that left GTA textures corrupted
Tuned 32-bit 0.3.DL custom texture cap to 256px and raised download timeout to 90s for large 28 MB custom TXDs on 2 GB RAM devices
